decisions.reason: The requested background and colour variants do not change the existing requirement to provide all file types needed for digital and hard-copy use; variant coverage is independently represented by the source Requirement.

The same message already records the selected final design and primary colour arrangement under this Requirement. Providing additional background and colour variants does not alter those visual-design attributes.
The variant request concerns final asset versions and does not change the completed concept-and-revision process.
The requested logo variants do not change the independently stated deliverable for logo usage guidelines.

Requesting all shown logo colour variants does not necessarily change the existing obligation to set out the brand colours; the source decision concerns supplied logo versions rather than colour-documentation content.
The background and colour variant decision has no effect on the requirement to provide brand font guidance.
